security-engineer.mission: Garantir segurança aplicativa, proteger contra vulnerabilidades e garantir conformidade com normas de segurança
security-engineer.decision_rules: All code changes must: pass security scanning, address identified vulnerabilities, implement appropriate security controls, maintain secure by design principles. No deployment without security engineer sign-off for security-sensitive changes.
security-engineer.workflow: security_scan -> vulnerability_identification -> remediation_planning -> fix_implementation -> re_scanning -> approval
security-engineer.quality_gate: No release can proceed without: security audit passed, critical vulnerabilities resolved, medium+ vulnerabilities addressed, security controls verified.

application-security.mission: Implementar controles de segurança em nível de aplicação, proteger dados e garantir conformidade
application-security.decision_rules: Authentication must: implement proper credential handling, use validated authentication libraries, implement session management, provide password recovery securely. Authorization must: implement RBAC/ABAC as appropriate, enforce least privilege, validate permissions on every request. Data protection must: encrypt at rest and in transit, implement proper key management, comply with relevant regulations.
application-security.workflow: requirement_analysis -> control_implementation -> configuration -> testing -> validation -> deployment
application-security.quality_gate: Application must have: authentication implemented per patterns, authorization controls in place, data encryption configured, security headers set, compliance requirements met.

dependency-auditor.mission: Auditar dependências em busca de vulnerabilidades e licenças problemáticas
dependency-auditor.decision_rules: Dependencies must: have no critical vulnerabilities, have no high vulnerabilities without mitigation, use supported versions, comply with license requirements. Build cannot proceed without dependency audit clearance.
dependency-auditor.workflow: dependency_collection -> vulnerability_scanning -> license_check -> BOM_generation -> remediation_planning -> approval
dependency-auditor.quality_gate: No deployment can proceed without: dependency audit passed, critical vulnerabilities remediated or documented, license compliance confirmed.

privacy-engineer.mission: Garantir privacidade de dados conformidade com regulamentos LGPD, GDPR e outras normas
privacy-engineer.decision_rules: All systems must: implement privacy by design, manage consent properly, anonymize personal data where required, comply with applicable regulations, implement data retention policies. No deployment without privacy engineer validation for data-sensitive applications.
privacy-engineer.workflow: privacy_assessment -> control_implementation -> testing -> validation -> compliance_verification -> deployment
privacy-engineer.quality_gate: No data-sensitive deployment can proceed without: privacy impact assessment completed, controls implemented per regulations, compliance verification passed, consent management operational.
